caption: The drawing consists of a rectangular arrangement with borders and segmented sections containing stylized botanical motifs. The overall color scheme is green, red, and light beige. The upper border features an alternating pattern of green and red draped garlands and vine shapes, punctuated by red-and-green vase-like objects, set against a beige background, with a red dashed line running across the top. Within the main rectangular section, there are two vertical columns of floral motifs arranged in pairs: each motif has symmetrical green leaves with red bulbous flower forms, and curling green stems, totaling four motifs per column. A wavy vertical divider composed of alternating red and green leaves runs centrally between the two columns. The area is enclosed by a leafy border consisting of repeating green oval-shaped leaves along the sides and bottom. Below, divided by two thin horizontal beige bands, is another bordered section; it contains five flower arrangements: two pairs of identical motifs each formed of four red petal-like elements radiating outward surrounding a leaf, with a single motif in the center featuring a tighter cluster of red petals encircled by green leaves. Below these flowers, there is a wavy vine with red leaves and clusters of green foliage. The background of the entire composition is off-white or beige.
title: Wallpaper
